units.source_text: 他将身靠在壁上，神情异常苦闷，中纳言君看了觉得可怜。

en.t: He leaned his body against the wall, his expression unusually anguished, and Chūnagon no Kimi felt sorry for him when she saw it.

units.source_text: 胧月夜回想昨夜之事，越发羞涩难堪，心中懊恼万分。

en.t: Oborozukiyo thought back on what had happened the night before, feeling still more ashamed and distressed, and her heart was filled with remorse.

units.source_text: 但又觉得这个人好比花阴，毕竟可爱。

en.t: Yet she also felt that this man was like the shade beneath blossoms, charming after all.
